title: finding(plugin-chatbot): two docs Properties rows (`maxHeight`, `processVisibility`) are live on only a subset of the three `chatbot*` registrations, and the flat table never says so
body:
Found during the objectui#6687 read-site census (the `surface` row). Filed unassigned; **not** the `surface` defect — this one is independent of how #6687 resolves.

## The fact

`content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx`'s `## Properties` table is presented as one flat list for the plugin, but the page documents **three** registrations (`chatbot`, `chatbot-enhanced`, `chatbot-floating`) and two of its rows are live on only a **subset** of them. The table never says which.

Read-site census on `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx` (counting `schema.KEY` reads inside each registration body):

| Row | `chatbot` | `chatbot-enhanced` | `chatbot-floating` | Table discloses the scope? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `maxHeight` | 1 | 1 | **0** | no |
| `processVisibility` | **0** | 1 | **0** | no |

`chatbot-floating` forwards neither: `FloatingChatbot` is handed `floatingConfig.panelHeight` instead of `maxHeight`, and no `processVisibility` at all. `chatbot` forwards no `processVisibility`.

So an author who writes `processVisibility: 'debug'` on a `chatbot` or `chatbot-floating` node, or `maxHeight` on a `chatbot-floating` node, gets **nothing, silently** — the same silent-drop failure mode as #6687, one notch weaker (the key is live *somewhere*, so it is not a zero-read-point row; it is a scope over-claim).

## Control

The same query on the same table run against the other 23 rows: 22 are live on all three registrations, and `surface` is the only row with zero read points anywhere (that one is objectui#6687). So the query resolves reads correctly and these two are genuine subset rows, not query artifacts.

## Reproduce

```
# target rows vs. a control row that must hit on all three
grep -c "schema.maxHeight"        packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx   # 2, not 3
grep -c "schema.processVisibility" packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx  # 1, not 3
grep -c "schema.placeholder"       packages/plugin-chatbot/src/renderer.tsx  # 3  (control)
sed -n '137,163p' content/docs/plugins/plugin-chatbot.mdx                    # the flat table
```

## Why it is worth a row of its own

The 2026-08-29 ruling on #6687 states the principle directly — "the table never again claims more than the registrations deliver". These two rows claim more than the registrations deliver, in the scope dimension rather than the existence dimension, and they do so under **either** resolution of #6687. Likely fix: a per-row scope annotation (or a per-registration split of the table), which is also the shape #6687's own docs row needs.
